_comment: System 1, J5: "who knows X" questions for the Ask tab, each with its project and the Insights component it is about (agent.config.json projects[].insights.components). Written to measure the component answer on questions, which the first checkpoints learned only from ticket texts: the Ask router answers without Claude only above a component threshold, chosen from these. English, Italian and Serbian. The first fifteen are the labelled 'who' questions of ask-intents.json.
